p: scroll: Because the Jews had provoked God's plagues by condemning his word, and casting off all judgment and equity, he shows that God's curses written in this book had justly happened both to them and their fathers. But now if they would repent, God would send the same among the Chaldeans and their former enemies.
stealeth shall be cut off as: That is, does any injury toward his neighbour.
side according to it: Meaning, wherever he is in the world.
sweareth shall be cut off as: He that transgresses the first table of the ten commandments, and does not serve God correctly but abuses his name.
ephah that goeth forth: Which was a measure in dry things, containing about five gallons.
resemblance through all the earth: That is, all the wickedness of the ungodly is in God's sight, which he keeps in a measure, and can shut it or open it at his pleasure.
talent of lead: To cover the measure.
woman that sitteth in the midst: Which represents iniquity, as in the next verse.
wickedness: Signifying that Satan would not have such power against the Jews to tempt them, as he had in times past, but that God would shut up iniquity in a measure as in a prison.
women: Which declared that God would execute his judgment by the means of the weak and infirm.
Shinar: To remove the iniquity and affliction that came from Judah because of the judgment, to place it forever in Babylon.
